questions.stem: When two lines intersect each other, what are the angles that are opposite to each other called?
questions.solution: Vertically opposite angles are the angles that are opposite to each other when two lines intersect. They are always equal. Adjacent angles are next to each other, linear pairs add up to 180°, and supplementary angles are any two angles that add up to 180°, but they are not necessarily opposite.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a method to draw a line parallel to a given line?
choices: Using a protractor to measure the angle 90°
Using a compass to draw arcs at equal distances
Sliding a set square along a ruler
Folding the paper to create a perpendicular line and then drawing another perpendicular
questions.solution: Sliding a set square along a ruler is the correct method because it allows the user to maintain a consistent angle while drawing a line parallel to the original. Using a protractor to measure 90° only creates a perpendicular line, not a parallel one. Drawing arcs with a compass may help in constructing angles but does not guarantee parallelism. Folding paper to create a perpendicular line and then drawing another perpendicular would result in a line that is not necessarily parallel to the original.

questions.stem: What is the term used to describe two lines that never meet and are always the same distance apart?
questions.solution: Parallel is the term used for two lines that never meet and remain the same distance apart. Perpendicular lines meet at right angles, intersecting lines cross each other at any angle, and crossing is not a formal geometric term for this concept.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about two lines that are both perpendicular to the same line?
choices: They are parallel to each other
They are perpendicular to each other
questions.solution: The correct answer is that they are parallel to each other. If two lines are both perpendicular to the same line, then they form equal corresponding angles (90°) with that line, making them parallel. The other options are incorrect because intersecting at two points is not possible for straight lines, being perpendicular to each other would mean they form a right angle, and forming a triangle requires three lines.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दो रेखाओं के बारे में सही है जो एक ही रेखा के लंबवत हैं?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true when two lines are parallel?
choices: They form a linear pair of angles.
They never meet and are always the same distance apart.

questions.solution: The correct answer is that parallel lines never meet and are always the same distance apart. This is a basic property of parallel lines. The other options are incorrect because parallel lines do not intersect, they do not form a linear pair, and they do not necessarily form right angles with a transversal.

questions.stem: If a transversal intersects two parallel lines, what is the sum of the interior angles on the same side of the transversal?
questions.solution: When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, the interior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary. This means they add up to 180°. The other options are incorrect because 90° is for perpendicular lines, 120° is not a standard angle for this case, and 360° would be the total of all angles around a point, not just the interior angles on one side of the transversal.

hi.stem: यदि एक तिर्यक रेखा दो समांतर रेखाओं को काटती है, तो तिर्यक रेखा के एक ही ओर के आंतरिक कोणों का योग क्या होता है?
hi.solution: जब एक तिर्यक रेखा दो समांतर रेखाओं को काटती है, तो तिर्यक रेखा के एक ही ओर के आंतरिक कोण संपूरक होते हैं। इसका अर्थ है कि वे 180° के बराबर होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि 90° लंब रेखाओं के लिए होता है, 120° इस मामले के लिए एक मानक कोण नहीं है, और 360° एक बिंदु के आसपास सभी कोणों का कुल योग होता है, न कि केवल तिर्यक रेखा के एक ओर के आंतरिक कोणों का।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard mathematical terminology as taught in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true when two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal?
questions.solution: When two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, alternate interior angles are equal. This is a fundamental property of parallel lines. The other options are incorrect: corresponding angles are equal, not supplementary; consecutive interior angles are supplementary, not equal; and not all angles are equal unless the lines are perpendicular, which is not stated here.

questions.stem: In the given diagram, line segment AB is parallel to CD and AD is parallel to BC. If ∠DAC is 65° and ∠ADC is 60°, what is the measure of ∠CAB?
questions.solution: Since AB is parallel to CD and AD is a transversal, ∠ADC and ∠DAB are supplementary. So, ∠DAB = 180° - 60° = 120°. ∠DAB is the sum of ∠DAC and ∠CAB. So, ∠CAB = 120° - 65° = 55°. The other options are incorrect because they do not follow the correct angle relationships.

questions.stem: If two lines are parallel, and a transversal intersects them, which of the following is true about the corresponding angles?
questions.solution: When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, the corresponding angles are equal. This is a key property of parallel lines and transversals. questions.stem: The lines representing the given pair of linear equations are non-intersecting. Which of the following statements is true?
choices: The lines intersect at one point
questions.solution: If the lines are non-intersecting, they never meet, which is a defining characteristic of parallel lines. Coincident lines are the same line and thus overlap entirely, not remaining separate and non-intersecting.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समांतर खींची गई रेखा अन्य दो भुजाओं को समान अनुपात में विभाजित करती है, इस प्रमेय का उपयोग करके सिद्ध कीजिए कि एक समलंब चतुर्भुज के विकर्णों के प्रतिच्छेद बिंदु से गुजरने वाली आधार के समांतर रेखा असमांतर भुजाओं को समान अनुपात में विभाजित करती है। सिद्धांत में कौन सा चरण सही है?
choices: समांतर रेखाओं और तिर्यक रेखाओं के गुणों का उपयोग करें

hi.solution: सही चरण समांतर रेखाओं और तिर्यक रेखाओं के गुणों का उपयोग करना है, क्योंकि यह सिद्धांत के लिए आवश्यक अनुपाती संबंध स्थापित करता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि रेखाओं के समांतर होने का अनुमान दिए गए शर्त के विरोध में है, और आकृति के समबाहु या वर्ग होने का सिद्ध करना आवश्यक नहीं है और प्रमेय से संबंधित नहीं है।

mr.stem: त्रिकोणाच्या एका बाजूला समांतर रेषा काढली असता इतर दोन बाजू एकसारख्या गुणोत्तरात विभाजल्या जातात, या सिद्धांताचा वापर करून ट्रॅपेझियमच्या आधाराला समांतर रेषा आणि विकर्णांच्या छेदनबिंदूमार्गे जाणारी रेषा असल्यास असमांतर बाजू एकसारख्या गुणोत्तरात विभाजल्या जातात, हे सिद्ध करा. खालीलपैकी कोणता एक पुराव्यातील योग्य टप्पा आहे?

mr.solution: योग्य टप्पा समांतर रेषा आणि छेदकांच्या गुणधर्मांचा वापर करणे आहे, कारण हे पुराव्यासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या प्रमाणीकरणाच्या संबंधांचे निर्माण करते. इतर विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण रेषा समांतर नाहीत असे गृहीत धरणे दिलेल्या अटीच्या विरुद्ध आहे आणि आकृतीचे समभुज किंवा चौरस असे सिद्ध करणे अवाजवी आणि थ्योरमशी संबंधित नाही.
